keywords: beans bean planting sow season haricot semer semis plantation ibiharage gutera kurima
en: Plant beans when the rains are established and the soil is moist, not on the first shower.
fr: Semez les haricots quand les pluies sont installees et le sol humide, pas a la premiere averse.
rn: Tera ibiharage imvura imaze gutangura neza kandi ivu rifise amazi.

keywords: bean rust orange brown spots leaves rouille haricot taches feuilles ibiharage amababi indwara
en: Rust shows as small orange-brown spots. Remove badly hit leaves, do not work wet plants, and ask an adviser.
fr: La rouille forme de petites taches orange. Enlevez les feuilles atteintes et consultez un conseiller.
rn: Indwara ya rouille iba utudomo tw'umuhondo. Kura amababi yafashwe, ubaze umujejetafu.

keywords: angular leaf spot grey brown patches beans tache angulaire feuilles haricot ibiharage amababi indwara
en: Angular leaf spot makes grey-brown angular patches. Use clean seed and rotate crops next season.
fr: La tache angulaire forme des plaques grises. Utilisez des semences saines et faites une rotation.
rn: Iyi ndwara itera ibibara ku mababi. Koresha imbuto nziza kandi uhindure ivyo utera.

keywords: maize corn armyworm caterpillar worm holes leaves mais chenille legionnaire ibigori ibinyabwoya udukoko
en: Check maize leaves weekly for holes and caterpillars. Crush egg masses and report outbreaks to an adviser.
fr: Inspectez le mais chaque semaine. Ecrasez les oeufs et signalez les attaques a un conseiller.
rn: Raba ibigori buri ndwi. Sigisa amagi y'udukoko, umenyeshe umujejetafu.

keywords: storage store dry drying grain harvest weevil mould stockage conserver secher grains recolte kubika kwumisha ingano
en: Dry grain fully before storing. Keep it off the floor in clean, sealed bags to limit insects and mould.
fr: Sechez bien les grains avant stockage. Gardez-les dans des sacs propres et fermes, hors du sol.
rn: Umisha neza imbuto imbere yo kuzibika. Zibike mu mifuko isukuye, ntizegere hasi.

keywords: banana wilt yellow leaves ooze xanthomonas BXW bananier fletrissement intoke insina kuma indwara
en: Wilting and yellow leaves can mean banana wilt. Do not share tools, remove the male bud, and alert an adviser.
fr: Le fletrissement peut indiquer le wilt bacterien. Ne partagez pas les outils et alertez un conseiller.
rn: Insina zumye zishobora kuba zirwaye. Ntusangire ibikoresho, umenyeshe umujejetafu.

keywords: cassava mosaic cuttings streak manioc mosaique boutures imyumbati ibiti indwara
en: Plant cassava only from healthy cuttings. Leaves with yellow mosaic patterns should not be used for planting.
fr: Plantez le manioc avec des boutures saines. Evitez les plants aux feuilles en mosaique.
rn: Tera imyumbati ivuye ku biti bitarwaye. Ntukoreshe ibifise amababi yanduye.

keywords: soil fertility compost manure erosion mulch sol fertilite fumier paillage ivu ifumbire
en: Add compost or manure before planting. Cover soil with crop residue to keep water and slow erosion.
fr: Apportez compost ou fumier avant le semis. Couvrez le sol pour garder l'eau et limiter l'erosion.
rn: Shira ifumbire imbere yo gutera. Twikira ivu kugira ngo rigumane amazi.

keywords: late rain dry drought no rain delayed replant pluie retard secheresse imvura yatinze amapfa
en: If rains are late, wait for moist soil before planting, and ask an adviser about short-season varieties.
fr: Si la pluie tarde, attendez un sol humide et demandez conseil sur les varietes a cycle court.
rn: Imvura iyo itinze, rindira ko ivu rigira amazi, ubaze umujejetafu ku mbuto zitinda gato.

keywords: flood flooding water lake river inondation eau lac riviere umwuzure amazi ikiyaga
en: In a flood warning, move people and seed to higher ground first. Follow local authorities and official alerts.
fr: En cas d'alerte, mettez personnes et semences en hauteur. Suivez les autorites locales.
rn: Umwuzure ugiye kuza, jana abantu n'imbuto ahantu hejuru. Kurikira abategetsi.
